transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?
I don’t know… I just haven’t felt like myself. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like the old Ruben, the guy who could talk to anybody and enjoy the day, is just… gone.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to look forward to bowling, messing around in the garden, taking my wife to gallery shows… even going dancing sometimes. Now I just kind of sit there and make excuses. None of it feels worth the effort.
Have you been feeling fatigued or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t done much physically?
I’m not really sure… I mean, I feel worn down sometimes, but I haven’t paid much attention to whether it’s energy or just… everything.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days, I think. I wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling, and it kind of stays there. Like the part of me that used to enjoy things or talk to people is just… not there.
Have you been feeling guilty or felt like you’re not worth much lately?
Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m just useless now. Like all those years taking care of clients, providing for my family… somehow none of it counts because I can’t even handle this job anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been keeping track. I guess I haven’t noticed anything big with my weight or eating.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or been restless and unable to sit still?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that, exactly… I guess I’m just slower in general, but I don’t know if other people would say that.
Have you had any thoughts about death or dying, or if it would be better if you weren’t around anymore?

…Yeah. I don’t like saying it, but… I’ve had thoughts that maybe my wife and kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up.

And that scares me. I don’t really trust myself like I used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About eight months, I guess. Since that new regional manager came in and started… coming down on me, taking accounts I’d had for years.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than a couple of weeks?
Not really… I mean, I’ve had bad stretches like anyone, but nothing like this. Not for weeks on end, I don’t think.

This rules out F32.0 (mild) and F33.0 (recurrent mild) due to the presence of more severe symptoms including suicidal thoughts.

The patient has described symptoms consistent with a major depressive episode with a duration exceeding two months and significant functional impairment. The presence of suicidal ideation, anhedonia, depressed mood, and feelings of worthlessness supports the diagnosis of moderate to severe depression, either as a single episode (F32.2) or recurrent (F33.2). The chronicity and persistence of symptoms over eight months raise the likelihood of a recurrent course, but without explicit confirmation of prior episodes, both remain plausible.
